dialogues.speaker: Chihu Rock Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Chihu Rock Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng's Ironmongers Ad
dialogues.text: Hanfeng's cold blades are sharp as can be!

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng's Ironmongers Ad
dialogues.text: Hanfeng's Ironmongers is the blacksmith of the people! Whether you are a gallant knight or a common old lady, we have just the blade for you!
